Mystery 'Space Balls' Debris Washes Ashore on Australian Beach

Six pieces of unidentified debris, potentially space junk, have washed ashore on Forrest Beach in Queensland, Australia. Authorities are investigating the origin of the mysterious objects, with experts suggesting they could be 'space balls' from a rocket. The investigation is being conducted in coordination with emergency management authorities.
